# JavaScript UDF cases from BigQuery's documentation:
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/user-defined-functions#javascript-udf-structure

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION multiplyInputs(x FLOAT64, y FLOAT64)
RETURNS FLOAT64
LANGUAGE js
AS r"""
  return x*y;
""";
SELECT multiplyInputs(2, 10)
=> "20.0"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION plusOne(x FLOAT64)
RETURNS FLOAT64
LANGUAGE js
AS "return x+1;";
SELECT plusOne(5)
=> "6.0"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION plusOne(x FLOAT64)
RETURNS FLOAT64
LANGUAGE js
AS "return x+1;";
SELECT SUM(plusOne(x)) FROM UNNEST([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]) AS x
=> "20.0"

# BigQuery's answers to cases that its documentation does not settle.
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x STRING) RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE js AS "return x === null ? 'null' : typeof x;";
SELECT f(NULL)
=> "null"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() RETURNS FLOAT64 LANGUAGE js AS "return undefined;";
SELECT f() IS NULL
=> "true"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() RETURNS INT64 LANGUAGE js AS "return '9007199254740993';";
SELECT f()
=> "9007199254740993"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() RETURNS INT64 LANGUAGE js AS "return 1.5;";
SELECT f()
=> "2"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() RETURNS INT64 LANGUAGE js AS "return 2.5;";
SELECT f()
=> "3"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() RETURNS INT64 LANGUAGE js AS "return -2.5;";
SELECT f()
=> "-3"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE js AS "return 1;";
SELECT f()
=> "1"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE js AS "return true;";
SELECT f()
=> "true"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() RETURNS STRING LANGUAGE js AS "return [1, 2];";
SELECT f()
=> "1,2"

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() RETURNS FLOAT64 LANGUAGE js AS "return Promise.resolve(1);";
SELECT f()
=> "1.0"
